description: Photovoltaic power data Photovoltaic power data is a data set deposited in ScienceDB (Science Data Bank) by its authors Xueqin ZHANG (China Three Gorges University). PV power dataset of a 150kW PV plant in Ningxia, China throughout 2018. The dataset includes power, temperature, relative humidity, wind speed, wind direction, and barometric pressure. Coverage: national (CN); the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 3906801 bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-sciencedb-repository.
